name: dynamic-yield
description: Operate Dynamic Yield: QA campaigns and recommendations with the Experience API, report events, sync the product feed, read user profiles and, through the DY console, manage campaigns and read experiment reports.

metadata.short_description: QA and manage Dynamic Yield campaigns, read experiment reports, report events and sync the product feed.
metadata.mesh_description: The **Dynamic Yield** MCP wraps Dynamic Yield's public server-side APIs. **Serve**: DY_CHOOSE runs the Experience API choose call for a page context (HOMEPAGE, CATEGORY, PRODUCT, CART, OTHER) and returns campaign payloads, recommendation slots, decision ids and analytics metadata; it accepts dyApiPreview tokens to QA unpublished variations and does not count as a pageview by default. **Collect**: DY_TRACK_PAGEVIEW, DY_TRACK_EVENTS and DY_TRACK_ENGAGEMENT report real data, so use them with test users. **Product feed**: DY_FEED_BULK upserts, partially updates or deletes up to 100 products per call in an API-synced feed, and DY_FEED_TRANSACTION_STATUS checks the result. **Profiles**: DY_USER_PROFILE reads Profile Anywhere affinity data. **Authentication**: a server-side DY API key (Settings › API Keys) sent as the connection token, with the Experience API and Feed ACLs as needed; set the data center (US or EU) in the configuration. **Console (DY_ADMIN_*)**: Dynamic Yield has no public API for campaigns or reports, so these tools call the internal API of the DY console (adm.dynamicyield.com) with your console session: list sections, goals and data feeds and trigger a feed sync; get, create, update, pause, archive and delete campaigns; get, create, update and delete audiences (targeting conditions) and recommendation strategies (algorithm and filter rules); and read experiment reports per variation and metric. Set adminEmail and adminPassword (a console user with email + password login; the MCP logs in and renews the session itself) and sectionId in the configuration. 2FA/SSO accounts can paste the RefreshToken cookie into adminSession instead (valid 7 days). Saving a campaign publishes it immediately. This API is undocumented and may change.
